name: diameter
label: Diameter
description: Propeller diameter D: the blades and the hub scale with it; the bore stays that of a 50 mm shaft

name: pitch_ratio
label: Pitch ratio P/D
description: Face pitch over diameter, the same at every radius

name: area_ratio
label: Expanded area ratio
description: Which member of the B4 series: B4-40, B4-55 or B4-70

name: tip_thickness
expr: ((b_series[8].thickness_a - b_series[8].thickness_b * blade_count) * (1 - tip_section_ratio) + b_series[9].thickness_a * (tip_section_ratio - b_series[8].radius_ratio)) / (1 - b_series[8].radius_ratio) * diameter

name: root_scale
expr: min(1, root_fit_width / max((b_series[1].leading_ratio * root_chord + edge_thickness) * cos(root_pitch_angle), ((1 - b_series[1].leading_ratio) * root_chord + edge_thickness) * cos(root_pitch_angle) + root_thickness * sin(root_pitch_angle)))

name: series_section_area_02
expr: (((b_series[1].thickness_a - b_series[1].thickness_b * blade_count) * diameter - edge_thickness) * ((1 - b_series[1].thickest_ratio) * b_series[1].fill_trailing + b_series[1].thickest_ratio * b_series[1].fill_leading) * b_series[1].chord_factor * chord_scale + edge_thickness * b_series[1].chord_factor * chord_scale + pi * edge_thickness^2 / 4)

name: series_section_area_03
expr: (((b_series[2].thickness_a - b_series[2].thickness_b * blade_count) * diameter - edge_thickness) * ((1 - b_series[2].thickest_ratio) * b_series[2].fill_trailing + b_series[2].thickest_ratio * b_series[2].fill_leading) * b_series[2].chord_factor * chord_scale + edge_thickness * b_series[2].chord_factor * chord_scale + pi * edge_thickness^2 / 4)

name: series_section_area_04
expr: (((b_series[3].thickness_a - b_series[3].thickness_b * blade_count) * diameter - edge_thickness) * ((1 - b_series[3].thickest_ratio) * b_series[3].fill_trailing + b_series[3].thickest_ratio * b_series[3].fill_leading) * b_series[3].chord_factor * chord_scale + edge_thickness * b_series[3].chord_factor * chord_scale + pi * edge_thickness^2 / 4)

name: series_section_area_05

name: series_section_area_06
expr: (((b_series[5].thickness_a - b_series[5].thickness_b * blade_count) * diameter - edge_thickness) * ((1 - b_series[5].thickest_ratio) * b_series[5].fill_trailing + b_series[5].thickest_ratio * b_series[5].fill_leading) * b_series[5].chord_factor * chord_scale + edge_thickness * b_series[5].chord_factor * chord_scale + pi * edge_thickness^2 / 4)

name: series_section_area_07
expr: (((b_series[6].thickness_a - b_series[6].thickness_b * blade_count) * diameter - edge_thickness) * ((1 - b_series[6].thickest_ratio) * b_series[6].fill_trailing + b_series[6].thickest_ratio * b_series[6].fill_leading) * b_series[6].chord_factor * chord_scale + edge_thickness * b_series[6].chord_factor * chord_scale + pi * edge_thickness^2 / 4)

name: series_section_area_08
expr: (((b_series[7].thickness_a - b_series[7].thickness_b * blade_count) * diameter - edge_thickness) * ((1 - b_series[7].thickest_ratio) * b_series[7].fill_trailing + b_series[7].thickest_ratio * b_series[7].fill_leading) * b_series[7].chord_factor * chord_scale + edge_thickness * b_series[7].chord_factor * chord_scale + pi * edge_thickness^2 / 4)

name: series_section_area_09
expr: (((b_series[8].thickness_a - b_series[8].thickness_b * blade_count) * diameter - edge_thickness) * ((1 - b_series[8].thickest_ratio) * b_series[8].fill_trailing + b_series[8].thickest_ratio * b_series[8].fill_leading) * b_series[8].chord_factor * chord_scale + edge_thickness * b_series[8].chord_factor * chord_scale + pi * edge_thickness^2 / 4)

name: series_section_area_tip
expr: ((tip_thickness - edge_thickness) * ((1 - b_series[8].thickest_ratio) * b_series[8].fill_trailing + b_series[8].thickest_ratio * b_series[8].fill_leading) * tip_chord_factor * chord_scale + edge_thickness * tip_chord_factor * chord_scale + pi * edge_thickness^2 / 4)

name: series_blade_volume
expr: (b_series[1].radius_ratio * prop_radius - root_section_radius) * (1 + root_scale^2) / 2 * series_section_area_02 + 0.1 * prop_radius / 3 * (series_section_area_02 + 4 * (series_section_area_03 + series_section_area_05 + series_section_area_07) + 2 * (series_section_area_04 + series_section_area_06) + series_section_area_08) + 0.1 * prop_radius * (series_section_area_08 + series_section_area_09) / 2 + (tip_section_ratio - b_series[8].radius_ratio) * prop_radius * (series_section_area_09 + series_section_area_tip) / 2 + (1 - tip_section_ratio) * prop_radius * (series_section_area_tip + (edge_thickness * tip_chord + pi * edge_thickness^2 / 4)) / 2
